changes.title: Record verified TEST233 evidence
changes.text: Retain the exact TEST233 targeted, core, Android, visual and APK evidence without rebuilding or publishing unchanged application source.

changes.title: Reject malformed run-end completion
changes.text: A checksum-valid but unreadable run-end payload no longer marks a run finished or authorizes an unredacted current-run history export.

commentary: TEST233 is the immediate previous produced APK and TEST231 remains the latest privately delivered fallback. The malformed run-end correction requires exact before/after core evidence and one complete TEST234 application gate; no automatic delivery.
